protocol.entry: Actual factor-adjusted open at market session t+1
protocol.stop: Close <= entry*(1-.08); trigger at close, exit at next market-session actual open
protocol.trailing: Peak starts at entry and uses subsequent closes only; activate at +20%, trigger at 8% retreat from that peak
protocol.horizon_exit: If no earlier trigger, exit at actual open t+h+1; a trigger on close t+h retains its stop reason
protocol.stop_priority: First trigger wins; if hard and trailing trigger together, hard stop takes priority
protocol.downside: max(0, 1-min(entry open, intraday lows through last held close, exit open)/entry); exclude all exit-day intraday lows
protocol.first_passage: First close at upper gain (.10,.15,.30) or at -8% during t+1...t+h, independently of any earlier trailing exit; otherwise neither
protocol.passage_ties: Inclusive boundaries; positive upper and negative lower are disjoint, so a close cannot hit both; earliest session wins
protocol.complete_window: Require every actual OHLC/factor quote from t+1 through t+h+1, including after an early reference exit; no fill or compressed calendar
protocol.label_maturity: Always market session t+h+1, not early exit date; training requires label_end strictly before cutoff
protocol.missing_labels: NaN payoff/downside, -1 passage/reason/indices, valid=False; label_end remains calendar-based when that session exists
protocol.quote_presence: Actual supplied OHLC and adjustment-factor quote; this label-only flag never changes feature eligibility
protocol.adjustment: Raw OHLC times actual same-day adj_factor; no future-normalised qfq series
protocol.execution_scope: Reference label omits official future locked-limit execution, fees and model-switch exits; exact account execution remains separate
